name: Gmm Pfaudler Ltd.
summary: GMM Pfaudler Limited, headquartered in Mumbai, India, is a global enterprise dedicated to the engineering, manufacturing, installation, and upkeep of corrosion-resistant industrial equipment and comprehensive chemical process systems. Serving both domestic and international markets, their solutions are vital for chemical, pharmaceutical, and other manufacturing sectors. The company's broad portfolio features glass-lined technology, including reactors, mixing systems, baffling, storage tanks, receivers, columns, instrumentation, and heat and mass transfer units. They also specialize in laboratory and process glassware, offering components, apparatus, mixing vessels, reaction and filtration systems, distillation and evaporation setups, absorption/extraction units, scrubbers, and OEM solutions for NORMAG. Key capabilities extend to filtration and drying equipment, such as solid-liquid separation and vacuum drying, complemented by expert mixing technology services. Furthermore, GMM Pfaudler provides advanced sealing solutions, including dry9000 for DIN-dimensioned agitators and mixers, ace5000, and FleXeal mechanical seals. They are a significant supplier of alloy process equipment, covering heavy engineering items, mixing systems, heat exchangers, columns, reactors, pressure vessels, wiped film evaporators, and tantalum process equipment. Their offerings also encompass fluoropolymer products for critical applications in chemical, pharmaceutical, semiconductor, and pulp & paper industries, along with machined PTFE and other engineered plastics. Additional services and systems include pilot testing and scale-up, instrumentation and controls, temperature control units, modular reaction systems, distillation columns, and integrated modular evaporation and distillation systems. They also provide expertise in wiped film evaporators, acid recovery, absorption, extraction, and membrane separation systems. Founded in 1962 as Gujarat Machinery Manufacturers Limited, the company rebranded to GMM Pfaudler Limited in 1999.
